description: This file implements an OpenAI-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion class that integrates with OpenAI's API to upload files, handle embeddings internally, and manage vector store creation. It skips the embedding step explicitly, relying on OpenAI's backend, and provides methods for storing files and associating them with vector stores.

classes.name: OpenAIRAGIngestion
classes.description: A subclass of BaseRAGIngestion implementing OpenAI-specific logic for file ingestion and vector store interaction, designed to leverage OpenAI's internal embedding capabilities.

methods.name: __init__( self, ingest_options: "RAGIngestOptions", router: Optional["Router"] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAIRAGIngestion with provided ingestion options and optional router.

methods.name: Optional[List[List[float]]] embed( self, chunks: List[str], )
methods.description: Overrides the embed method to skip embedding as OpenAI handles it internally; returns None.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] store( self, file_content: Optional[bytes], filename: Optional[str], content_type: Optional[str], chunks: List[str], embeddings: Optional[List[List[float]]], )
methods.description: Stores files by creating or reusing a vector store, uploading the file to OpenAI, and attaching it to the vector store, leveraging OpenAI's backend to handle chunking and embedding.
